'''The Sink Hole''' was was an area of the [[Agrilat Region|Agrilat Swamp]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was the second piece of terrain that the contestants of the [[Agrilat Swamp Circuit]] had to race through.<ref name="SWG:AST" />
